Experienced IT professional with over 12+ years in the Core Banking industry, specializing in Investment banking solutions, Intellimatch Reconciliation. Proven track record in managing and implementing centralized banking systems to enhance operational efficiency and customer service.

Complete understanding of SDLC processes and Agile & Waterfall Methodologies. • Proficient in creating Business Requirement Document, Functional Requirement Document, Use Case specification Document, Workflows, Implementation guides, Functional Specification Document, and Requirement Refinement. • Strong understanding of core banking functionalities including account management, Derivatives, Reconciliation, and transaction monitoring.

Well versed in Requirement Elicitation & Prioritization, Defining Scope, Gap Analysis, Stakeholder Analysis & Management, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Product Backlog Management, and Change Request Management.

Use Case Jira Unit Testing Requirement prioritization

Sprint retrospective

Epics Release planning

BRD | FRD | FSD

User Stories Scrum – Agile

Requirement Elicitation & Gathering

Daily Scrum Call Stakeholder Management Technical Writing Domain Knowledge. Microsoft Power BI

Professional Experience:-

BCT Consultancy- Client-BNP Paribas - Mumbai Role:- Business Analyst.

Jan’2025 – Feb’2026

Worked with BNP Paribas in Reconciliation team. We support Operation team on recon related issues by using Intellimatch application such as New Recon setup, any enhancement in existing Recon, Matching rule or Recon frequency change Reporting etc.

Requirement gathering and preparing User Stories\BRD\FRD Walk through requirement with Dev team in Product Refinement calls. Conduct daily scrum call, meetings, follow up on Jira tickets. Attend BAU calls and provide status Assist team on UAT and follow ups with users. Sprint Planning and prioritization of Jira tickets. Perform ad-hoc requests if any during current sprint. Act center point of contact for all project activities liaising with Delivery Managers.

TrainSmart IT Services - Mumbai Role:- Business Analyst.

Dec’2023 – Nov’2024

Requirement gathering and preparing User Stories, BRD Conduct daily scrum call, meetings, follow up on Jira tickets. Attend BAU calls and provide status. Assist team on UAT and follow ups with users. Sprint Planning and prioritization of Jira tickets. Perform ad-hoc requests in any during current sprint.

Training to new joiners in the team.

HCL Client- Statestreet Bank- Mumbai Role:- Business Analyst.

Aug’2015 – Sep. 2023

During my tenure with HCL, I spearheaded a pivotal project focused on enhancing reporting capabilities, crucial for informed decision-making and regulatory compliance. Leveraging advanced analytics and streamlined Reconciliation processes, I optimized reporting structures, enabling stakeholders to access real-time data insights efficiently. This experience honed my ability to navigate complex financial landscapes.

Elicit & Translate Business requirements to User Stories\BRD\FRD\SRS. Led multiple core banking system projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to budget

constraints.

Conduct Gap Analysis\Impact Analysis on Business Process using techniques like use case diagrams (UML) \ Flow charts. Skilled in risk management, Quality assurance, and stakeholder communication within core banking projects. Verification \ Validation of requirements to ensure they deliver business value by conducting various Reviews and workshops

with clients.

Performed quality assurance (functional testing) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) facilitating on-time, on-budget and

Acclaimed “go-live” of the application.

Act center point of contact for all project activities liaising with Delivery Managers. Migrated Derivative process from China.

Syntel-Client-Statestreet Bank – Mumbai Role :- Senior Associate.

May’2008 – Apr. 2014

Reconcile clients' books of accounts with the External Custodian, focusing on equity portfolio management. Conducted daily cash recon between Custodian bank & Investment Manager using TLM - Transaction Lifecycle

Management, Internal and external Payments.

Perform tie-outs and true-ups for monthly and quarterly accounts, ensuring timely statement approval. Monitor and manage client accounts, including financial transactions and service

usage.

Interact with clients for MIS reporting via emails and conference calls.
